summary: Standards: gate's PLAN_STALE message is 'the plan digest X no longer matches the plan (now Y)', so a refused caller is handed the digest of the plan as it is now and can commit it at once without re-running the preview its meta.next points at, which is the review step the digest exists to force (spec 12.5, 12.7). It is carried over unchanged from canon's safety.rs:117, so it is not a regression, but the crate is the place every tool inherits it from and gate has no way to leave it out. Blast radius: canon-0-35-plan-jcs adopts this message when it moves safety.rs onto the crate; test 08 asserts only code, exit, field and next, not the message.
